speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify your symptoms: since you recently finished antibiotics for sinusitis, have you developed a new fever or noticed any pain in your side or back? Also, have you experienced any changes in your urine color or frequency?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text:

speaker: Doctor
text: That rash reaction to amoxicillin but not cephalexin is a notable clue, but given your fever, flank pain, and fatigue, we must confirm if your urine shows signs of infection before finalizing the cause. Did you notice any blood in your urine or a foul odor? REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of binucleated cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm on the stain is highly suggestive of an eosinophilic infiltration, which can occur in drug-induced interstitial nephritis or acute allergic interstitial nephritis. However, given your fever, flank pain, and leukocyturia, this presentation strongly points to acute pyelonephritis, potentially complicated by or mimicking an allergic reaction to the antibiotics. Are you currently experiencing any rash or itching now? DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyelonephritis
